scenarios.name: metalcraft-two-artifacts-is-short
scenarios.why: The Scribe and Bonesplitter are the only two artifacts, one short of the stated three-artifact threshold, so its tap ability is unavailable.

scenarios.name: metalcraft-three-artifacts-gives-energy
scenarios.why: The Scribe and two Equipment permanents meet the three-artifact threshold; gaining energy during its controller's turn triggers its team-wide bonus.
